The system features a modern web-based interface, robust backend integration with Google Gemini for live AI responses, and comprehensive error handling and logging. - Modern chat UI for seamless user interaction
- Real-time AI-powered responses using Google Gemini
- Context injection from curated Q&A datasets
- RESTful API endpoints for chat and answer retrieval
- Comprehensive error handling, logging, and monitoring
- Responsive design and accessibility compliance
- Secure integration and privacy controls
- OpenAPI documentation for backend endpoints
- Scalable architecture for future enhancements

steps.name: environment - persist frontend environment and verify Node/NPM
steps.description: Verify node and npm exist and meet minimal LTS major (>=18). Write an idempotent /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh that exports FRONTEND_WORKSPACE pointing to the workspace and ensures project-level node_modules/.bin and npm global prefix/bin are added to PATH at shell startup. Export NODE_ENV with a safe default. Provide version reporting for debugging. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
# verify node/npm
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
# parse major semver robustly
NODE_V_RAW=$(node -v || true)
NODE_V=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_V_RAW" | sed -E 's/^v//' | cut -d'-' -f1)
NODE_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_V" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ -z "$NODE_MAJOR" ] || ! printf "%s" "$NODE_MAJOR" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "ERROR: could not parse node version: $NODE_V_RAW" >&2; exit 4
fi
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node major version $NODE_MAJOR < 18 required" >&2; exit 5; fi
# write profile idempotently; export FRONTEND_WORKSPACE and NODE_ENV default
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh
MARKER="# FRONTEND_ENV - autogenerated"
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE" && sudo grep -q "$MARKER" "$PROFILE"; then
  : # already written
else
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# FRONTEND_ENV - autogenerated
# set workspace for frontend dev scripts
export FRONTEND_WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
# default NODE_ENV when not set
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
# add npm global prefix/bin to PATH at runtime if present
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NB="$(npm config get prefix 2>/dev/null)/bin"
  if [ -n "$NB" ] && [ -d "$NB" ] && ! echo ":$PATH:" | grep -q ":$NB:"; then
    export PATH="$NB:$PATH"
  fi
fi
# add project node_modules/.bin when present
if [ -n "$FRONTEND_WORKSPACE" ] && [ -d "$FRONTEND_WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin" ] && ! echo ":$PATH:" | grep -q ":$FRONTEND_WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin:"; then
  export PATH="$FRONTEND_WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"
fi
EOF
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
fi
# report versions for visibility
echo "NODE: $(node -v)"; echo "NPM: $(npm -v)"

steps.name: scaffolding - idempotent create-react-app initialization
steps.description: Create a minimal CRA project in the workspace non-interactively if the workspace is empty (no package.json and no non-dot files). Detect TypeScript (tsconfig.json or REQUEST_TS=1) and pass --template typescript when initializing. Prefer system create-react-app binary if present, else use npx fallback. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
# if package.json exists, assume project present
if [ -f package.json ]; then echo "SKIP: package.json exists"; exit 0; fi
# if dir not empty (other than dotfiles) skip to avoid overwriting
if [ -n "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name '.*' -printf '.' -quit)" ] || [ -n "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '.' ! -name 'node_modules' -printf '.' -quit)" ]; then
  echo "SKIP: workspace not empty and no package.json present"; exit 0
fi
# determine template
TEMPLATE=""
if [ -f tsconfig.json ] || [ "${REQUEST_TS:-0}" = "1" ]; then TEMPLATE="--template typescript"; fi
# prefer installed create-react-app, else npx fallback
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  create-react-app . --use-npm $TEMPLATE --silent
else
  npx --yes create-react-app . --use-npm $TEMPLATE --silent
fi
# ensure package.json created
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "ERROR: CRA did not create package.json" >&2; exit 2; fi

steps.name: dependencies - install project dependencies deterministically
steps.description: Install project dependencies using deterministic installers according to lockfile: npm ci for package-lock.json, yarn install --frozen-lockfile for yarn.lock, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile for pnpm-lock.yaml (if pnpm present); fall back to npm install. Ensure dev/test dependencies (@testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, dotenv) are declared in package.json and add them if missing, then run installer once. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "ERROR: package.json missing, run scaffold first" >&2; exit 2; fi
# helper to check package.json devDependencies/dependencies for a pkg
has_pkg() { pkg="$1"; jq -e ".dependencies[$(printf '%s' "$pkg" | jq -R .)]? // .devDependencies[$(printf '%s' "$pkg" | jq -R .)]? | select(.)" package.json >/dev/null 2>&1; }
# add missing dev deps to package.json (minimal versions omitted to prefer registry/latest)
ADD_DEPS=()
jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: jq required to parse package.json" >&2; }
for p in "@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "dotenv"; do
  if ! (jq -r '.dependencies // {} + .devDependencies // {} | has("'"$p"'")' package.json 2>/dev/null) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ADD_DEPS+=("$p")
  fi
done
if [ ${#ADD_DEPS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  # add as devDependencies in package.json then run installer
  for p in "${ADD_DEPS[@]}"; do
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev "$p"
  done
fi
# select installer by lockfile
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
elif [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --silent
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
fi
# verify node_modules
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo "ERROR: node_modules missing after install" >&2; exit 3; fi

steps.name: testing - scaffold deterministic test and run unit tests
steps.description: Create a minimal deterministic React component and react-testing-library test. Detect TypeScript (tsconfig.json) to create .tsx/.test.tsx otherwise .jsx/.test.jsx. Hello-Dev

steps.name: validation - build, serve production bundle, smoke-check, and cleanup
steps.description: Build the app with NODE_ENV=production, serve the built bundle on port 5000 using npx serve in its own process group, wait for HTTP 200 with retries, capture evidence (status and first 512 bytes), then cleanly kill the process group and exit. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "ERROR: package.json missing" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Build with production env
NODE_ENV=production npm run build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/frontend_build.log
if [ ! -d build ] || [ ! -f build/index.html ]; then echo "ERROR: build artifacts missing, see /tmp/frontend_build.log" >&2; exit 3; fi
# start serve in its own process group
PORT=5000
LOG=/tmp/frontend_serve.log
setsid npx --yes serve -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
# SERVER_PID is the pid of the background process; kill negative pid to target process group
trap 'kill -TERM -"$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT TERM INT
# wait for HTTP 200 with retries
MAX_WAIT=60
SLEEP=1
i=0
SUCCESS=0
while [ $i -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
  if curl -fS -m 5 -o /tmp/frontend_body.html "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SUCCESS=1; break
  fi
  i=$((i+1))
  sleep $SLEEP
done
if [ $SUCCESS -ne 1 ]; then echo "ERROR: server did not respond with HTTP 200 within timeout; see $LOG" >&2; cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 4; fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# validation - build, serve production bundle, smoke-check, and cleanup
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/knowledge-bot-f38ec8c2/Frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure package.json exists
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "ERROR: package.json missing" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Build with production env and capture logs
NODE_ENV=production npm run build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/frontend_build.log
if [ ! -d build ] || [ ! -f build/index.html ]; then echo "ERROR: build artifacts missing, see /tmp/frontend_build.log" >&2; exit 3; fi
# Start serve in its own process group on port 5000
PORT=5000
LOG=/tmp/frontend_serve.log
setsid npx --yes serve -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
# Ensure process group is terminated on exit or signal
trap 'kill -TERM -"$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT TERM INT
# Wait for HTTP 200 with retries (up to MAX_WAIT seconds)
MAX_WAIT=60
SLEEP=1
i=0
SUCCESS=0
while [ $i -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
  if curl -fS -m 5 -o /tmp/frontend_body.html "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SUCCESS=1
    break
  fi
  i=$((i+1))
  sleep $SLEEP
done
if [ $SUCCESS -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: server did not respond with HTTP 200 within timeout; see $LOG" >&2
  echo "--- serve log ---" >&2
  sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true
  exit 4
fi
# capture evidence: HTTP status implied by curl success and first 512 bytes
HEAD_SNIPPET=$(head -c 512 /tmp/frontend_body.html | tr -d '\r\n')
# Output a single-line validation success with snippet
echo "VALIDATION_OK: HTTP 200, snippet: ${HEAD_SNIPPET}"
# Clean shutdown of the server process group
kill -TERM -"$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT TERM INT
